description: Phase 1 controlled Graph2Mat graphene SIESTA/W90 sweep. DeepH comparison is a follow-up over selected Graph2Mat winners, not launched by this payload.

md.label: graphene_w90_phase1_ood1000
md.split_intent: Blocked split with temporal gap: train is 300 K, validation is 200 K, test is an explicit mixed low/high-temperature OOD set at 100 K and 400 K.

screening_caveats.iid300: Cheap 200-epoch broad screen; use as exploratory signal, not as final DeepH follow-up unless confirmed at larger size.
screening_caveats.checkpoint_policy: Graph2Mat saves best validation checkpoint via ModelCheckpoint monitor=val_loss; this is checkpoint selection, not true early stopping.

scientific_caveat: This is not a reproduction of the DeepH paper; it is a controlled cross-architecture benchmark under the local SIESTA/W90 pipeline.
